name: ct_head
description: Order a CT head to evaluate acute intracranial hemorrhage, stroke, mass effect, hydrocephalus, and traumatic brain injury. Non-contrast is the standard for acute trauma and stroke.

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., head trauma, acute stroke, headache with red flags)

when_to_use: acute head trauma with loss of consciousness or focal neurologic deficit
suspected stroke or transient ischemic attack (CT without contrast, then CTA if large vessel occlusion suspected)
worst headache of life — rule out subarachnoid hemorrhage
new-onset seizure with prolonged postictal state
suspected intracranial mass, abscess, or hydrocephalus (with contrast)

examples.query: Patient found down, GCS 8, unequal pupils

args.clinical_indication: acute head trauma with herniation signs

examples.query: Sudden worst headache of life, nuchal rigidity
